classification.difficultyReason: The hardest parts require constructing an auxiliary perpendicular or using symmetry to obtain component lengths, then combining calculated segments into the requested whole length. These extend the taught embedded-triangle method through routine geometric links.

content.prompt: Calculate the missing side in these triangles. Round your answer to two decimal places.

spec.description: Rotated rectangle, four right-angle marks and a dashed diagonal; the long edges rise to the right.
spec.mathematics: Diagonal 19.3 cm, long side 18 cm, short side q.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and q are visible.

spec.description: Horizontal rectangle with descending dashed diagonal and bottom-left right-angle mark.
spec.mathematics: Perpendicular sides 2 m and 3 m; diagonal d.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and d are visible.

spec.description: Inverted isosceles triangle; top-to-apex perpendicular and external height dimension; 11.6 cm dimension spans the right half-base only.
spec.mathematics: Half-base 11.6 cm, altitude 24.6 cm, equal sloping sides q.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and q are visible.

answer.worked:
The altitude bisects the base of the isosceles triangle.
$$\begin{align*}q&=\sqrt{11.6^2+24.6^2}\\q&=\sqrt{739.72}\\q&\approx27.20\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Square with four double-tick sets, four right-angle marks and descending dashed diagonal.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and d are visible.

spec.description: Clockwise-rotated square; dashed segment begins above the bottom-left vertex; h measures only the upper left-side segment.
spec.mathematics: All sides 12.5 cm; dashed hypotenuse 17 cm; perpendicular shorter side h.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and h are visible.

answer.worked:
The top side is $12.5\text{ cm}$ because all four sides are equal.
$$\begin{align*}h&=\sqrt{17^2-12.5^2}\\h&=\sqrt{132.75}\\h&\approx11.52\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Slanted quadrilateral with horizontal top and bottom, perpendicular dashed diagonals, and labels on the lower two half-diagonals. No equality, bisection or parallel marks are added.
spec.mathematics: Lower half-diagonals 10.3 cm and 8.5 cm; top side p. Source does not establish equality of opposite half-diagonals.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and p are visible; the intended rhombus assumption is not inserted.

answer.worked:
The diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other. The upper right triangle therefore has perpendicular sides $10.3\text{ cm}$ and $8.5\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}p&=\sqrt{10.3^2+8.5^2}\\p&=\sqrt{178.34}\\p&\approx13.35\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Square with four single-tick sets, bottom-left right-angle mark and dashed segment starting above the bottom-left vertex. External 9.2 cm dimension measures only the upper left-side segment.
spec.mathematics: Dashed hypotenuse 14.1 cm; vertical leg 9.2 cm; square side f is the horizontal leg.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and f are visible.

answer.worked:
The top and bottom sides are equal.
$$\begin{align*}f&=\sqrt{14.1^2-9.2^2}\\f&=\sqrt{114.17}\\f&\approx10.69\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Quadrilateral with rising upper side, horizontal dashed construction from the top-left vertex, three right-angle marks and an external full-height dimension.
spec.mathematics: Width 23 cm, left height 4 cm, total right height 18 cm, sloping side w.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and w are visible.

answer.worked:
The vertical side of the upper right triangle is $18-4=14\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}w&=\sqrt{23^2+14^2}\\w&=\sqrt{725}\\w&\approx26.93\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upright isosceles triangle with equal-side ticks, dashed altitude and a right-angle mark; w labels the entire base.
spec.mathematics: Equal sides 15.2 cm, altitude 8.6 cm, full base w.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and w are visible.

answer.worked:
The altitude bisects the base.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{w}{2}&=\sqrt{15.2^2-8.6^2}\\\frac{w}{2}&=\sqrt{157.08}\\w&=2\sqrt{157.08}\\w&\approx25.07\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Trapezium with vertical right side and two right-angle marks; no internal construction is supplied.
spec.mathematics: Parallel horizontal sides 18.2 cm and 23.1 cm; left sloping side 10.2 cm; height a.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and a are visible.

answer.worked:
Draw a perpendicular from the top-left vertex to the base. The small right triangle has horizontal side $23.1-18.2=4.9\text{ cm}$ and vertical side $a$.
$$\begin{align*}a&=\sqrt{10.2^2-4.9^2}\\a&=\sqrt{80.03}\\a&\approx8.95\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Trapezium with vertical left side and two left right-angle marks; no internal construction is supplied.
spec.mathematics: Height 15.4 cm, top 3.2 cm, sloping right side 22.6 cm, full base p.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and p are visible.

answer.worked:
Draw a perpendicular from the top-right vertex to the base. Let the horizontal side of the resulting right triangle be $b$.
$$\begin{align*}b&=\sqrt{22.6^2-15.4^2}\\b&=\sqrt{273.6}\\p&=3.2+\sqrt{273.6}\\p&\approx19.74\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Kite with external side-length dimensions, dashed perpendicular diagonals, single ticks on left sides, double ticks on right sides and triple ticks on the vertical half-diagonals. The 19 cm dimension spans the full vertical diagonal; y spans the full horizontal diagonal.
spec.mathematics: Left equal sides 10.5 cm, right equal sides 16.8 cm, bisected vertical diagonal 19 cm; find horizontal diagonal y.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and y are visible. A white label mask preserves the legibility of the bottom dimension label.

answer.worked:
Each half of the vertical diagonal is $19\div2=9.5\text{ cm}$. Let the left and right horizontal segments be $u$ and $v$.
$$\begin{align*}u&=\sqrt{10.5^2-9.5^2}\\u&=\sqrt{20}\\v&=\sqrt{16.8^2-9.5^2}\\v&=\sqrt{191.99}\\y&=\sqrt{20}+\sqrt{191.99}\\y&\approx18.33\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
